name: Runner Extras - Report.SaveAs record-filter overload
brief: Pins that the RecordRef handed to Report.SaveAs actually filters the report's matching data item.
description: Report.SaveAs(id, params, format, stream, recordRef) is how AL runs a report over one specific record — it is what every 'print this document' path does. BC applies the RecordRef's own filters to the data item over the same table. If the runner drops them, a document report that guards against unfiltered runs (Standard Sales - Invoice raises 'You must specify one or more filters to avoid accidentally printing all documents') refuses to run at all, and a report without such a guard silently renders every row instead of one.
